goal: Prove restart-safe persistence and idempotency for one venue-derived crypto scanner cycle, material state recording, and a clearly-labelled historical paper lifecycle replay without creating live orders.

contract.universe: Binance public TRADING USDT Spot + USD-M perpetual metadata, Spot/Futures separate
contract.persistence: SQLite artifact with scan_cycles, material_states, replay_trades; deterministic keys; same cycle applied twice across independent DB connections must not duplicate rows
contract.current_fill: Never fabricate next-bar-open; current signal may only be PAPER-ENTRY-QUEUED unless an observed next open is part of a later cycle
contract.replay: Historical lifecycle replay is not a current position and exists only to prove entry->exit->stats persistence

anti_tuning: No Quiet-RV parameter, asset, threshold, hold, decluster, cost, or strategy-status change. No removal of DOGE/LTC or other same-sample rescue.
